verdict.rationale: Ramp's llms.txt index links a canonical OpenAPI schema at /openapi/developer-api.json, alongside a generated plain-text endpoint/schema reference and full exports. An independent probe confirmed the file returns HTTP 200 as a parseable OpenAPI document ('Ramp Developer API' v1) with 174 paths. The unauthenticated Developer MCP server also exposes the OpenAPI schemas, and a probe confirmed it is reachable without keys.
